question:

The two frames were shot on the same fixture and are pixel-aligned, but their exposure differs slightly. The candidate regions below are normalized [x1, y1, x2, y2] in [0, 1] (origin top-left). At most one region of figure 2 contains a manufacturing defect that the golden sample does not have. Which region contains the defect?
(A) [0.8739, 0.8295, 0.9939, 0.9495]
(B) [0.4527, 0.0184, 0.5727, 0.1384]
(C) [0.6021, 0.1451, 0.7221, 0.2651]
(D) No defect in any of the above regions.

Answer with only the correct option letter.
